audience.text: Java developers building applications that require structural access to PSD and PSB files, especially those needing byte-exact round-trip preservation of file contents.

capabilities.text: The library parses Adobe Photoshop PSD and PSB file formats up to 30,000 px and 300,000 px respectively.
capabilities.title: PSD/PSB file parsing

capabilities.text: Supports reading and writing layer structures and embedded resources while preserving file integrity.
capabilities.title: Layer and resource handling

capabilities.text: Handles RAW, RLE, and ZIP (with/without prediction) compression schemes used in image data.
capabilities.title: Compression support

capabilities.text: Parses Indexed palette, RGB, and CMYK color modes; other modes are preserved as raw data.
capabilities.title: Color mode support

capabilities.text: Modifications preserve unmodified sections to ensure byte-exact round-trip file output.
capabilities.title: Byte-exact round-trip

capabilities.text: Uses Maven for building, testing, and dependency management with standard commands.
capabilities.title: Maven-based build

limitations.text: No pixel rendering or rasterization functionality is included; only structural and metadata access is provided.
Mask data and blending ranges are read-only; modification of these elements is not supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables parsing and modification of PSD/PSB file structure—including layers, resources, and image data—while preserving original compression and metadata.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Java is a free and open-source Java library for parsing and manipulating Adobe Photoshop PSD and PSB files without pixel rendering.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Developers run 'mvn test' to execute the test suite and 'mvn package' to build the JAR artifact.

workflows.name: Release workflow
workflows.text: The project uses a GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/maven-central-release.yml to publish releases to Maven Central.

workflows.name: Dependency installation
workflows.text: Developers install the library using Maven with the command 'mvn dependency:get -Dartifact=org.aspose:aspose-psd-foss:26.11.0'.
